Assicurare la manutenzione preventiva e correttiva degli impianti elettrici - Diagnoscere le interruzioni e intervenire rapidamente in caso di malfunzionamento - Eseguire lavori di riparazione, ripristino e messa in servizio - Buoni Reka: Siegfried AG concede ai propri collaboratori uno sconto del 20% - Cassa di previdenza aziendale attraente - Corsi di sport in loco e numerosi eventi aziendali - Accesso alla piattaforma di vantaggi per collaboratori Swibeco - Description "Expect to grow", personally and professionally: At Siegfried, we offer fascinating challenges and numerous opportunities to showcase your talents. As a trusted and respected partner in the pharmaceutical industry, we uphold the highest standards in safety, quality, and sustainability, while cultivating a culture that allows you to thrive. Join a global company in full expansion, where diverse perspectives and experiences come together in a collaborative environment. Here, you will find a workplace that values both collective success and your individual contributions—offering long-term opportunities to evolve and make an impact. ## Your Role As a maintenance technician specializing in electrical systems, you ensure the smooth operation of technical installations and guarantee safety and continuity of equipment. ### Your Main
• Responsibilities - Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical systems - Diagnose faults and intervene quickly in case of malfunction - Carry out repair, restoration, and commissioning work - Participate in the installation and commissioning of new equipment - Ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations - Prepare intervention reports and ensure a rigorous follow-up - Collaborate with internal teams and external suppliers ## Your
• Profile - Electrician's diploma, automation, or equivalent training - Confirmed experience in a similar role (industrial maintenance or building maintenance) - Good knowledge of electricity, reading of diagrams, and fault diagnosis - Autonomy, rigor, and sense of responsibility - Analytical spirit and reactivity in the face of unexpected events - Good interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team ## Your Benefits - Flexible working hours allowing you to balance family life, hobbies, and profession - Free parking - Health insurance: up to 10% discount on complementary insurance with our partners - Generous and customizable stock purchase plan - Child allowance: Siegfried AG increases the cantonal allowance by 10% and pays an additional CHF 100 per month - Opportunities for individual continuous training - Reka vouchers: Siegfried AG grants its employees a 20% discount - Attractive company pension fund - On-site sports courses and numerous company events - Access to the Swibeco employee benefits platform - 5 weeks of vacation and possibility of buying up to 2 weeks ## About Siegfried Founded in 1873 in Zofingue, Switzerland, Siegfried has become a global network of 13 sites spread across three continents. With a team of over 3,800 highly qualified professionals, we bring the innovations of our pharmaceutical clients to an industrial level and produce safe medicines for patients worldwide. As a fully integrated CDMO, Siegfried is one of the few organizations today able to ensure the development and production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished galenic forms under one roof. This unique combination of expertise and experience makes us the most reliable partner in the pharmaceutical industry. Siegfried is a leading pharmaceutical development and manufacturing company (CDMO), with its headquarters in Zofingen, Switzerland. The company operates production sites in Evionnaz (Valais), Zofingen (Aargau), and Schlieren (Zurich).

• Ihre Hauptaufgaben - Durchführen von vorbeugender und korrektiver Wartung an elektrischen Systemen - Diagnose von Fehlfunktionen und Eingreifen bei Malfunctionen - Durchführen von Reparatur-, Wiederherstellungs- und Inbetriebnahmearbeiten - Teilnahme an der Installation und Inbetriebnahme neuer Geräte - Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsstandards und -vorschriften - Erstellen von Eingriffsberichten und Sicherstellung eines strengen Follow-up - Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und externen Lieferanten ##
• Ihr Profil - Abschluss als Elektriker, Automatik oder äquivalentes Training - Bestätigte Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle (industrielle Wartung oder Gebäudewartung) - Gute Kenntnisse in der Elektrotechnik, Lesen von Diagrammen und Fehldiagnose - Autonomie, Strenge und Verantwortungsbewusstsein - Analytischer Geist und Reaktionsfähigkeit bei unerwarteten Ereignissen - Gute soziale Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeit, in einem Team zu arbeiten ## Ihre Vorteile - Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, Ihre Familie, Hobbys und Beruf zu vereinbaren - Kostenlose Parkplätze - Gesundheitsversicherung: bis zu 10% Rabatt auf zusätzliche Versicherungen bei unseren Partnern - Generöser und anpassbarer Aktienkaufplan - Kinderzulage: Siegfried AG erhöht die kantonalen Zulage um 10% und zahlt zusätzlich CHF 100 pro Monat - Möglichkeiten für individuelle Weiterbildung - Reka-Gutscheine: Siegfried AG gewährt seinen Mitarbeitern einen Rabatt von 20% - Attraktive Unternehmenspension - Sportkurse auf dem Betriebsgelände und zahlreiche Betriebsveranstaltungen - Zugang zur Plattform für Mitarbeiter von Swibeco - 5 Wochen Urlaub und Möglichkeit, bis zu 2 Wochen zu kaufen ## Über Siegfried Gegründet 1873 in Zofingue, Schweiz, hat sich Siegfried zu einem globalen Netzwerk von 13 Standorten auf drei Kontinenten entwickelt. Als vollständig integriertes CDMO ist Siegfried eine der wenigen Organisationen, die heute die Entwicklung und Produktion von Wirkstoffen (API) und fertigen Galenikformen unter einem Dach gewährleisten kann. descriptionByLocale.en: Description "Expect to grow" , personally and professionally: At Siegfried, you can expect exciting challenges and numerous opportunities to demonstrate your talents. As a trusted and respected partner of the pharmaceutical industry, we maintain high standards in safety, quality, and sustainability, while fostering a culture that enables you to succeed. Join a rapidly growing, global company where diverse perspectives and experiences come together in a cooperative environment. Here, you'll find a workplace that values both collective success and your individual contributions, offering you long-term opportunities to develop and make a difference. ## Your Role - In our laboratories, more than 90 colleagues work on the development of new processes and the control of adherence to the highest quality standards, supporting our customer-oriented and efficient production. We offer our employees exciting tasks and a high degree of variety. - Overall responsibility for coordinating analytical tasks within your projects (e.g., method development, transfer, validation, and troubleshooting) throughout the entire lifecycle, from evaluation to commercial production. - Technical leadership and analytical expertise within the assigned projects and technologies in the field of Small Molecules. - Representation of Siegfried to customers in project-related meetings, both on-site and virtually. - Central interface between Analytics, Chemical Development, Production, Quality Assurance, and other departments. - Support in the transfer of knowledge from analytical development to quality control. - Creation, maintenance, and review of analytical documents (e.g., specifications, method descriptions, validation and transfer reports, development and campaign reports). - Active participation in customer audits regarding analytical issues. - Tracking and control of the analytical cost budget within the project plan. - Compliance with cGMP regulations and safety standards within your area of responsibility to ensure maximum safety and quality. ## Your Profile ### Technical Skills - A Master's or PhD degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, or a comparable academic education forms the right basis for this role. - 2 to 3 years of professional experience in pharmaceutical analytics. - In-depth knowledge of chromatographic analysis techniques (e.g., HPLC, GC) in the field of Small Molecules is a must. - Knowledge of the application of spectroscopic and wet-chemical analysis techniques with Small Molecules is an advantage. - Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment is an advantage. ### Personal Strengths - Experience in project management helps you structure your workday. - You are service- and customer-oriented and enjoy working in a team. - Good German and English language skills in both written and spoken form. ## Your Benefits - Flexible working hours allow for the reconciliation of family, leisure, and work. - Whether you drive or not, you benefit: either discounted parking or CHF 60.–. - Monthly mobility allowance. - Health insurance: discounts of up to 10% on additional insurances with our partners. - The share purchase plan is generous and individually customizable. - Child allowance: Siegfried AG increases the child allowance by 10% compared to the cantonal approach. - Individual further training opportunities upon agreement. - Paid rest breaks, the well-being of our employees is important to us. - Reka-Geld: Siegfried AG grants a 20% discount to employees. - Pension fund: Our company pension fund is attractive and contributions are individually customizable. - Company restaurant / cafeteria: Food at preferential conditions. - Central location: Station nearby with very good public transport connections. - Access to exclusive corporate benefits and discounts for our employees. ## About Us Founded in 1873 in Zofingen, Switzerland, Siegfried has grown into a global network with 13 locations on three continents. With a team of over 3,800 highly qualified professionals, we bring our pharmaceutical customers' innovations into industrial production and manufacture safe medicines for patients worldwide. As a fully integrated CDMO, Siegfried is one of the few companies today that can combine the development and manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished dosage forms under one roof. This unique combination of expertise and experience makes us the trusted partner of the pharmaceutical industry.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Description "Expect to grow" , personnellement et professionnellement: chez Siegfried, vous pouvez vous attendre à des défis stimulants et de nombreuses opportunités de démontrer vos talents. Interface centrale entre l'Analytique, le Développement Chimique, la Production, l'Assurance de la Qualité et d'autres départements. - Soutien dans le transfert de connaissances du développement analytique au contrôle de la qualité. - Création, maintenance et révision de documents analytiques (par exemple, spécifications, descriptions de méthodes, rapports de validation et de transfert, rapports de développement et de campagnes). - Participation active aux audits clients concernant les questions analytiques. - Suivi et contrôle du budget des coûts analytiques dans le cadre du plan de projet. - Respect des réglementations cGMP et des normes de sécurité dans votre domaine de responsabilité pour garantir une sécurité et une qualité maximales. ## Votre Profil ### Compétences Techniques - Un diplôme de Master ou de Doctorat en Chimie, Pharmacie ou une formation académique comparable forme la base appropriée pour ce poste. - 2 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans l'analytique pharmaceutique. - Connaissances approfondies des techniques d'analyse chromatographique (par exemple, HPLC, GC) dans le domaine des Small Molecules sont un impératif. - Connaissances de l'application des techniques d'analyse spectroscopique et chimique humide avec les Small Molecules sont un avantage. - Expérience du travail dans un environnement réglementé par le GMP est un avantage. ### Forces Personnelles - L'expérience en gestion de projet vous aide à structurer votre journée de travail. - Vous êtes orienté service et client et vous aimez travailler en équipe. -
